fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of the API v3 app created in your Olist ERP (Tiny) account (Configurações > Aplicativos; https://api-docs.erp.olist.com/).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret of the same app, sent in the token request body.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from the one-time authorization-code exchange (https://accounts.tiny.com.br/realms/tiny/protocol/openid-connect/auth ... then /token with grant_type=authorization_code). Access tokens expire after 4 hours and are re-minted from it; the refresh token 'tem duração de 1 dia' and each refresh returns a new one, which replaces it in memory (set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to persist it across restarts).

me.note: GET /info: the connected ERP company {razaoSocial, cpfCnpj, fantasia, enderecoEmpresa, fone, email, regimeTributario}.

list_products.note: GET /produtos: the products registered in YOUR Olist ERP (an ERP/integration hub, not a supplier) [{id, sku, descricao, tipo, situacao (A/I/E), unidade, gtin, precos{preco, precoPromocional, precoCusto, precoCustoMedio}}]; `query` searches the name (nome). Prices are BRL. `category` is not a filter of this endpoint.

get_product.note: GET /produtos/{idProduto}: full product with stock (estoque.quantidade), suppliers (fornecedores[{id, nome, codigoProdutoNoFornecedor}]), category, brand, dimensions, variations and attachments in `raw`.

get_order.note: GET /ordem-compra/{idOrdemCompra}: a purchase order recorded in the ERP (ordem de compra to a supplier) {id, numeroPedido, data, dataPrevista, situacao, totalProdutos, frete, totalPedidoCompra, contato (supplier), itens[{produto, quantidade, preco}]}. Currency BRL.

not_offered.quote_shipping: Olist ERP is an ERP; the v3 API (https://api.tiny.com.br/public-api/v3/swagger/swagger.json) has no carrier-rate endpoint for a product and destination.
not_offered.create_order: POST /ordem-compra only records a purchase order inside the ERP (contato = supplier contact, itens[{produto{id}, quantidade, valor}]); it is not transmitted to or paid at any supplier, and the vocabulary's shipping_address has no counterpart.
not_offered.track: No tracking endpoint for purchase orders; tracking data belongs to sales orders and invoices and the v3 API only writes it (PUT /pedidos/{idPedido}/despacho, PUT /notas/{idNota}/despacho 'Atualizar informações de rastreamento'), it does not expose it per purchase order.

adapter.terms: Olist ERP API v3 (OAuth 2 via accounts.tiny.com.br Keycloak realm 'tiny'); API v2 (token query parameter, errors inside HTTP 200 retorno.status) is not used.
